description: This file is a bash script named 'pr_cycle.sh' that manages pull request review cycles for project components. It provides commands to start, stop, and clear review lifecycle dates stored in 'metadata.yaml' files within components, and generates reports accordingly. It includes functions for listing components, displaying help, resolving metadata paths, adding business days to dates, and clearing date fields.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Lists components by finding 'metadata.yaml' files and filtering out certain paths.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves and verifies the path to a component's 'metadata.yaml' file.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a new date by adding a number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears review lifecycle dates in a 'metadata.yaml' file by replacing the date fields with '~'.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG status report by calling an external script.
